---
title: SInfoNiA
description: "SInfoNiA, Olivier Gossner's project awarded an ERC Advanced Grant in 2024 and funded by UKRI."
---

**SInfoNiA — Strategic Information: New Directions and Applications** was awarded an ERC Advanced Grant in 2024 and is funded by UK Research and Innovation (UKRI).

The project studies how information shapes strategic interaction, developing foundations for the analysis of information in games and applications to coordination, financial stability and the design of incentives.

[Project website at CREST](https://crest.science/erc-grants/sinfonia/)
